proposed_capability: P95/P124/Trifecta: require an independently observed gameplay PAUSED state before Live-mode camera pixel target acquisition/click, while retaining SAFE_REST first, camera reanchor, fresh revision, scene/Sim target and player-first screen lease. Use EA-confirmed P/0 toggle only when game observed PLAYING; never toggle if PAUSED/UNKNOWN or auto-resume. Pause time does not immobilize camera; moving view still invalidates pixels. Preserve skill-force play-brief-observe-repause because some panels require Live ticks.
player_save_control_impact: Read-only planning, explicit one-shot admitted pause key, no game resume, no save writes, no background daemon and no changes to user pause or gameplay speed without verified active session and idle. Never steal keyboard focus; game speed unknown fails closed. Player can always interrupt, and the exact local game must independently confirm pause.
expected_outcome: Live-mode camera recovery returns GAME_PAUSE_REQUIRED (one P key after independent host/session/idle gate) when verified playing, GAME_PAUSE_REOBSERVE on unknown/mismatched clock, and existing camera reanchor/framing only when verified paused with fresh matching clock/camera capture. Native world clicks reject unpaused or stale clock at effect boundary; BUY/BUILD legacy calibration unchanged. One-shot local pause adapter revalidates clock before and after dispatch without repeatedly toggling.
negative_tests: Live mode PLAYING requests pause before target pixels
Already paused must never toggle P again
Unknown clock / stale capture / changed clock while action admitted must refuse
Pause button plus game clock stillness corroborate game is paused
Player camera, modal, text input, active keyboard, unknown scene or player queue blocks speed
Verified pause does not by itself establish stable camera: SAFE_REST, camera revision and world target still required
Different camera revision or pause state at final click rejects stale pixels
No automatic resume: agent/player-owned pause state preserved
Build/Buy fixed UI chrome and existing native click tests retain behavior
Skills panel may remain stale paused; bounded play-brief-observe-repause remains its own owner
No game launch, user save edits, global key hooks or background polling
rollback_path: Revert PR; all changes confined to repository; no installed game, saves, user settings, scripts or background schedulers mutated.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact active Sims patch and pause icon/time sensor require P08 local calibration and live Windows proof.
External agents bypassing BetterInstincts host cannot be forced to use pause-first path.
